title: Why you should stop wearing lifting gloves
summary: Short video telling viewers to stop wearing lifting gloves: they add a layer that lets the bar slip despite the knurling, they smell, go spongy and need replacing. Hands adapt to the bar within about a week; NH used to wear gloves himself.

claims.claim: Lifting gloves create an extra layer between hand and bar that lets the bar slip; barbells have aggressive knurling precisely so the bar sits in your bare hand without slipping.
The bar hurts at first, but if you stick with bare hands you won't feel it after about a week.
Gloves smell when worn daily, get spongy when washed and must be replaced, so they end up costing a lot of money.
NH used to wear gloves and refused to listen when people told him to lift bare-handed.
